content.text:
Image 1: Seven-panel storyboard reference, used for the overall shot structure, shot sizes, and camera-movement rhythm. Read it from left to right and from top to bottom; panel N is Shot N. It is a line-art sketch: do not adopt its sketch style, black outlines, white background, panel borders or drawn faces.
Image 2: Reference of INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, a rendered set, not live action. Use it only for the room's layout, the furniture's positions and the light's direction; do not reference its visual content. It contains no people.
Image 3: Reference of INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 4: Reference of INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 5: Reference of INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 6: Reference of INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 7: Blocking reference of the segment's start: the same place with these people in their places, used only for where each person is and which way they face; take faces and outfits from each subject's own image. It is a line-art diagram: do not adopt its outlines or white background.
Image 8: Subject 1 (Lu Shaoze, look S0) character appearance reference.
Image 9: Subject 2 (Ji Hongyuan) character appearance reference.
Image 10: Subject 3 (Ji Ran, look S1) character appearance reference.
Image 11: Prop 1 (document envelope) maps to this image; copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 11.
From each prop's image, use only structure, material, and color.
[Subject settings]
Subject 1 (Lu Shaoze): Refer to Image 8. 28, Ji Ran's ex-boyfriend of four years, driven away by Ji Hongyuan five years ago; now the arrogant heir of the Lu Group and Ji Ran's arranged fiancé. Outfit: look S0: Flashback, five years earlier, at 23: a fitted navy-blue fine-gauge merino knit long-sleeved polo sweater with a three-button placket, worn over dark charcoal-grey slim wool trousers with a black leather belt, and black leather derby shoes. A neat, grown-up look, already ambitious, with nothing loose or casual about it. Signature colour: blue.
Subject 2 (Ji Hongyuan): Refer to Image 9. 56, Ji Ran's father; a calculating wealthy businessman. Outfit: A tailored dark chocolate-brown suit jacket and matching brown trousers. A cream long-sleeved dress shirt, open at the collar with no tie. Polished brown leather loafers. Signature colour: brown.
Subject 3 (Ji Ran): Refer to Image 10. 27, heroine; owner of Jiejian Company, an architecture and interior design firm; daughter of Ji Hongyuan. Outfit: look S1: Flashback, five years earlier, at 22: a black fitted short-sleeved knit sheath mini dress with a rounded neckline that hugs her waist and hips. Black strappy heeled sandals. Her hair is long and straight. Signature colour: black.
Environment (INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM): Refer to Images 2 to 6. Flashback, warm afternoon sunlight. Warm afternoon sunlight through the French windows from the back and slightly from the left, and the crystal chandelier. Rustling leaves, quiet villa air, footsteps.
Do not swap the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions or dialogue.
[Subjects and relationships]
Only three people appear throughout: Lu Shaoze, Ji Hongyuan, and Ji Ran.
[Blocking]
Refer to Images 2 to 6 for the room and Image 7 for the people's places. Ji Hongyuan sits on the long cream leather sofa in front of the French windows, facing the front display cabinets. The low marble-and-gilt coffee table stands in front of him on the beige patterned carpet, and the kraft document envelope lies on it. Lu Shaoze, at 23, stands on the carpet on the near side of the coffee table, facing the sofa with his head bowed. He wears the fitted navy-blue knit polo sweater, the charcoal-grey wool trousers and black derby shoes. The younger Ji Ran, at 22, stands half-hidden behind the white marble column, which is in front of the left wall near the archway. She wears the black knit mini dress, her long hair straight, and peers around the column. Camera side: in front of everyone, on the display-cabinet side, facing the sofa and the windows.
[Overall style]
Photorealistic live-action short drama with cinematic lighting. Each character keeps the face and the outfit with its main colour from their reference image throughout. Use each character sheet only for that character: the face from the close-up on the right, the body and outfit from the turnaround on the left; do not render the sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. This segment has 2 lines, in this order: Ji Hongyuan, Ji Hongyuan. Generate speech only from the lines in {} in the shot list, each spoken exactly once by its speaker; everyone else keeps their mouth naturally closed while listening, and a V.O. speaker keeps their mouth closed or is off screen. Follow the shot list below; do not add cuts or camera moves beyond it. Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule: within a scene, characters keep their screen sides and the camera stays on one side of the axis. Seamless continuity of action; cut on action. For dialogue prefer static shot-reverse-shot and over-the-shoulder shots, balanced with reaction shots and close-up inserts. Faces stable and clear, with no resemblance to any real actor or actress. Normal human eyes. Natural anatomy. Natural, fluid motion that follows the blocking; characters make subtle, natural movements. Characters, props and environment share one world with matched lighting. Each line ends naturally with breathing room and is never cut off. Authentic performances with micro-expressions. No BGM; generate only dialogue, environmental sounds and action sounds. No subtitles.
[Continuity]
Maintain continuity in the identities, number, appearance, clothing, relative heights, spatial positions, and eyelines of all the characters. The actions in the shot list occur strictly in sequence. Hands are anatomically correct.
[Strictly exclude]
spatial jumps of the marble column and archway. added or missing characters. malformed hands. Dialogue from the wrong character, multiple people speaking at once, repeated or missing lines, lip-sync errors and audio-visual desynchronization. The raw reference images (character sheets, setting plates) appearing as a frame of the video, and starting on a still frame of the setting reference. A fast zoom-in at the start, a fast pull-back at the end, unmotivated whip-pans, tilts, zooms and 360-degree orbits. Axis-crossing, jump cuts, frame skips, flicker and clipping. Face swaps, changes in age or clothing, sudden height shifts, added or missing characters, spatial jumps, and disordered action sequences; props popping in or vanishing, and duplicate characters except mirror reflections. Hand clipping, extra fingers, fused fingers, malformed hands. Subtitles, captions, watermarks and garbled writing; writing and logos other than those on a key prop's reference image, which are copied from it; a phone screen or paper that is not a key prop is shown from the back or out of focus. Black-and-white, monochrome, grayscale, desaturated visuals; hand-drawn, sketch, line art, illustration, comics, animation; storyboard frames, rough sketches, panel borders, gutters and grid layouts.
[Shot list] (7 shots, approximately 18 seconds)
When a previous-shot reference image is given, it is the moment this segment starts from: keep its people's positions, outfits, props and light, and continue from there. Shot 1 keeps its own camera, matching the image's framing only when it frames the same view; do not repeat that frame later.
Shot 1 (0-2s): [Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the display cabinets facing the French windows] Leaves sway outside the sunlit French windows. Ji Hongyuan, on the cream sofa, sweeps the document envelope off the marble table with the back of his hand. It drops onto the carpet at the feet of Lu Shaoze, who keeps his head bowed. Ji Ran peers from behind the marble column by the archway. <A thick envelope thuds onto the carpet>
Shot 2 (2-7s): [Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lu Shaoze on the display-cabinet side, eye level, facing the sofa] Ji Hongyuan leans back on the cream sofa with his arms spread and looks at Lu Shaoze with contempt. Lu Shaoze's shoulder and the back of his head fill the foreground. Dialogue (Ji Hongyuan, in Chinese, slow and final): {我已经给纪然安排好了联姻对象，是陈氏集团的公子，}
Shot 3 (7-10s): [Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, low angle, from the coffee table side facing Lu Shaoze] Only Lu Shaoze, framed on the face and shoulders. He keeps his head down, swallows hard and clenches his jaw. Dialogue (Ji Hongyuan, in Chinese, cold): {也给你安排了国外的学校，}
Shot 4 (10-12s): [Close-up, fast push in, eye level, from the display-cabinet side facing the sofa] Ji Hongyuan's narrow eyes stay hard behind his gold-rimmed glasses. Dialogue (Ji Hongyuan, in Chinese, a flat command): {以后，不要再来找纪然。}
Shot 5 (12-13s): [Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the display-cabinet side] Ji Hongyuan snorts and turns his face away toward the fireplace. Dialogue (Ji Hongyuan, in Chinese, a dismissive grunt): {嗯。}
Shot 6 (13-16s): [Medium shot, follow Lu Shaoze from the coffee table to the archway, eye level, from the display-cabinet side] Lu Shaoze stoops, picks up the envelope from the carpet and walks toward the archway by the left wall. He passes the marble column without noticing Ji Ran, who stays hidden behind it with her fists clenched. <Paper crinkles, footsteps on marble>
Shot 7 (16-18s): [Medium close-up, clean single, handheld, high angle, from the room's centre facing the left wall] Lu Shaoze is gone through the archway. Ji Ran slumps back against the left wall beside the column, a hand on her chest, gasping for breath with wet eyes. <Ragged breathing>
At the end: Ji Hongyuan sits on the cream leather sofa in front of the French windows, his face turned away toward the fireplace. Lu Shaoze has left through the archway by the left wall with the envelope. Ji Ran leans slumped against the left wall beside the marble column, a hand on her chest, breathing hard.

Image 12 is the first frame.
